summary: Added the eval case plugin/evals/gate-review-real-misses: a state/v2 plan of seven sh gates (six cited defects reduced to their mechanisms, one sound), regex and llm graders, and a scaffold that proves each gate's defect on the host; listed in the evals README (with the macOS note) and the evals guide.
